author: Yffe
content: Fix the reopened sibling leak in forge/src/vacuity_solver.rs (the #13 vacuity-solver verus path has the IDENTICAL #53 temp-binary leak). Reuse check.rs's #53 ScratchDir Drop guard (DRY): make struct ScratchDir + fn unique_scratch_dir pub(crate) in check.rs (minimal visibility change), then in vacuity_solver::run_harness write <stem>.rs inside a per-run scratch DIRECTORY and run verus with current_dir = that dir so the compiled binary lands inside and the Drop guard removes it wholesale on every exit path. Crate-name gotcha intact. Add forge/tests/scratch_cleanup.rs::vacuity_harness_success_leaves_no_scratch_orphan (a tautology fixture — the harness SUCCEEDS, the leak case — leaves no forge_* entry in an isolated TMPDIR; skip-loud if verus absent). Verify #13 behavior unchanged + full gauntlet.
